claim.purpose: Reconcile v0.91.8 demo matrix and feature-proof coverage with current issue/proof truth without rerunning owned demos.

initial.title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][demo-matrix] Reconcile demo matrix and feature-proof coverage
initial.goal: Map every claimed v0.91.8 feature or launch surface to owning issue, exact proof or explicit blocker/non-claim/deferred disposition, and public claim boundary.
initial.required_outcome: DEMO_MATRIX_v0.91.8.md and FEATURE_PROOF_COVERAGE_v0.91.8.md agree with current issue and proof truth, backed by a focused deterministic validator.
authority_boundary: This issue owns matrix and feature-proof coverage truth only.
Owning issues retain authority over runtime, demo, deployment, podcast, Unity, and v0.92 handoff execution proof.
Planning, fixtures, screenshots, retained packets, and metadata must not be promoted into runtime proof.
operator_constraints: never touch or switch primary main
do not rerun demos owned by other issues
do not claim release readiness or v0.92 activation readiness
initial.task_boundary: Reconcile the two canonical v0.91.8 coverage docs and add focused deterministic validation.
deliverables: machine-readable coverage ledger or deterministic validator
explicit live demo, retained proof, blocker, non-claim, and deferred classifications
bounded exact-head review and ready PR closing #5733
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every matrix row names an owning issue and exact evidence or an explicit blocker/non-claim/deferred disposition.
AC-2: #5354 convergence output is consumed as input; #5733 does not rerun or replace integrated convergence.
AC-3: Demo evidence, runtime proof, documentation-only evidence, and planned work are not conflated.
AC-4: Unity, Runtime v3, ADL v2, C-SDLC v2, Observatory, distributed workcell, Podcast Studio, and v0.92 handoff rows preserve actual claim boundaries.
AC-5: Matrix and feature-proof coverage have no contradictory status or ownership entries.
AC-6: Focused validation and one bounded pre-PR review pass at the exact publication revision.
dependencies: current accepted revisions and proof packets named by the existing matrix
non_goals: implementing or rerunning product demos owned by other issues
converting planning, fixtures, screenshots, or metadata into runtime proof
claiming release readiness or v0.92 activation readiness
blocking this issue on typed closeout receipts
initial.plan_summary: Bootstrap #5733, inspect current issue/proof truth, reconcile the two canonical matrices with explicit claim boundaries, add a focused validator, record validation and review, then publish a ready PR.

steps.action: Initialize and bind issue-local C-SDLC v2 lifecycle state.
Inventory current matrix rows, feature-proof rows, #5354 convergence evidence, and issue-wave owner truth.
Update the canonical docs and add deterministic validation for owners, evidence, dispositions, and contradictions.
Run focused validation, exact-head review, publish, and shepherd the PR.

invariants: every live/proven claim has an owner and evidence
explicit blockers and non-claims are preserved rather than hidden
planned work and runtime proof remain separate
the #5354 convergence packet is consumed, not rerun
public claim boundaries stay narrower than internal evidence
risks: existing docs may contain stale issue status or proof language
validator may need to encode only stable document structure to avoid brittle prose coupling
stop_conditions: protected-path collision is reported by typed v2 binding
required #5354 evidence is absent or contradictory
focused validator fails after repair attempt
exact-head review returns actionable in-scope findings

validation_lanes.proof_role: Focused deterministic validation for owner, evidence, disposition, and contradiction coverage in the v0.91.8 demo matrix and feature-proof coverage docs.
Git diff whitespace hygiene for the bounded documentation and validator changes.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on stale issue/proof claims, missing owner, missing evidence/disposition, contradictory matrix rows, validator failure, or stale exact-head review.
review_prompts: Check that every matrix and feature-proof row has a truthful owner and evidence or explicit disposition.
Check that #5354 evidence is consumed without rerunning or overstating integrated convergence.
Check that demo, retained proof, blocker, non-claim, and deferred categories are not conflated.
Check that the validator is deterministic and not brittle beyond the bounded matrix contract.
